summary: The target-valid family A=(1-2delta)J+delta vv^T-delta uu^T+2delta I with balanced orthogonal sign vectors and delta=n^(-1/2) has three large eigenvalues, unit positive diagonals, PSD physical pairs and balanced positive triangle signs, yet every fixed-size original-coordinate principal or cross block has all singular values beyond the first tending to zero. Thus no universal fixed-size packet extraction can close the balanced near-rank-one chamber; high-cardinality product-bank aggregation is necessary. This does not refute QFORM.
